covers: The Sega Master System video chip (315-5124) and its 315-5246 and 315-5377 successors as a chip

left_out.why: Master System II VDP: same ports and register file as sega315_5124 (listed in its types); the entries and the register texts name where it differs (extra 224 and 240 line modes, no address mask bugs).
Game Gear VDP: same ports and register file as sega315_5124 (listed in its types); only its colour RAM, the sprite zoom limits and the timing differ, which the data port and register texts say.

entries.name: Sega 315-5124 SMS1 VDP
entries.description: Master System video chip: a TMS9918 derived background and sprite generator with its own 16 KB video RAM, colour RAM, counters and interrupts.
entries.behaviour: Four ports: data (video RAM and colour RAM), control (address, code or register write, and status), vertical counter and horizontal counter. Modes 0 to 3 are chosen by M1, M2 or M3 alone (none is mode 0); M4 selects mode 4, where the 315-5246 and 5377 also take 224 and 240 line screens from M2 with M1 or M3.

handlers.control_write: control port write: address, code or register write
